task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Take hold of the lightweight handheld barcode scanner using the right arm, grab the beige cube with golden leaf patterns using the left arm, and scan it.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架后，右臂握住轻便的手持式条码扫描器，左臂抓住带有金叶图案的米色立方体并进行扫描。
